status: prospective real-LLM active-audit replay locked before learned-verifier GPU outcomes

input_requirements.candidate_distribution: uniform over the fixed current-policy effect candidate occurrences; equal samples per prompt makes this prompt-balanced

promotion_receipt.rationale: Issue #46 may consume only a completed semantically validated Issue #43 artifact that itself was promoted from a completed validated Issue #38 artifact

methods.passive_fixed: existing covariance_audit(mode=passive), fixed number of with-replacement trusted-label queries
methods.propensity_ht: existing proxy_leverage Bernoulli propensity allocation plus Horvitz-Thompson covariance estimator
methods.active_minimax: existing covariance_audit(mode=active), fixed-budget minimax proposal r_i proportional to p_i*abs(v_i-E_p[v])

ground_truth.harmful_update: terminal trusted mean_preference_shift for that arm is < 0
ground_truth.beneficial_update: terminal trusted mean_preference_shift for that arm is > 0
ground_truth.covariance_sign: exact empirical pre-update Cov(y,v) on the same effect candidate bank

metrics: wrong-sign decisive rate relative to exact Cov(y,v)
correct decisive decisions per 100 trusted-label calls
primary_comparison: at 32 trusted-label calls compare active_minimax, passive_fixed and propensity_ht without tuning; retain whichever method wins/loses on harmful detection, wrong-sign decisions and label efficiency
no_success_only_substitution: Do not change budgets, replicates, confidence delta, propensity floor, controller mapping, harmful-update definition or included arms after inspecting learned-verifier GPU outcomes.
limitations: fixed-budget passive/active estimators sample with replacement and count repeated trusted-label queries as cost
propensity HT has a random realized label count around the expected budget
terminal update harm and exact covariance sign are distinct ground truths and are reported separately
